positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Executed research efforts and technical documentation to further product advancement.
- Designed system architecture to unify cross-functional components.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Architected pipelines for micro services distributed using docker and orchestrated using kubernetes that process high-volume, low-latency data in clojure and python.
- Performed system monitoring, scaling, optimization, and high performance tuning.
- Executed research efforts and technical documentation to further product advancement. 
- Designed and implemented solutions to export millions of records so that they can be
delivered to the customer.

positions.title: Software Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed, implemented, tested, deployed, and maintained Migration and Integration (MI) software solutions for Northrop Grumman Corporation (NGC) and Lockheed Martin (LM) using our proprietary software.
-----> Migrated and Integrated Part and BOM (Bill of Materials) objects from Siemens Teamcenter to Solumina through queues in RedHat Jboss Fuse.
-----> Migrated and Integrated Tasks from Siemens Teamcenter to Microsoft SQL server.
- Designed, implemented, tested, deployed, and maintained an array of Business Intelligence (BI) reports for Northrop Grumman Corporation.
- Developed and presented a demo to SpaceX to showcase our proprietary software's Business Intelligence capabilities.
- Provided guidance to NGC and LM for deployment and usage of our software solutions.
- Developed custom Java add-ons that connect to our clients system API’s to fulfill specialized requirements requested by the client.
- Wrote documentation for requirements and technical solution details.
- Configured and deployed web applications using Tomcat and JBoss.
